description: Every VPC endpoint carries a policy naming or conditioning its principals and allowing no wildcard action; the one open-principal statement is ECR's layer bucket, a declared exception scoped to that bucket and GetObject

principal_exceptions.reason: ECR's image-layer bucket. Pulls fetch layers by pre-signed URL from ECR's own bucket, so the request carries no project principal to name; the statement is bounded to this one AWS-owned bucket and s3:GetObject (network.tf, AllowECRLayerPull)
